title: Place images
goal: Each place keeps its photos locally
acceptance: Attach images to a place; thumbnails; files in the git-ignored data folder
GPS and other EXIF metadata stripped on import; tests with an invented image
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
